sloka: तम् परिष्वज्य धर्मात्मा आतस्मात्सरयूतटात् ।आनयामास ता गोपैस्त्रिजटायाश्रमम् प्रति ॥२-३२-३८॥
transliteration: tam pariṣvajya dharmātmā ātasmātsarayūtaṭāt ।ānayāmāsa tā gopaistrijaṭāyāśramam prati ॥2-32-38॥

translations.english: The staff he hurled crossed the bank of the river Sarayu and fell near a bull in the midst of a thousands cows.
